scope: Published generator artefacts and their authoritative semantic content. Internal scheduling history and temporary layout are excluded.

environment_classes.PINNED: Same code, dependency lock, architecture, worker count and deterministic kernel configuration.
environment_classes.PERMITTED_PORTABLE: A separately approved hardware/runtime combination whose floating-point outputs may use the declared tolerance rule. Identifiers, topology, categories and completion states remain exact.

artifact_families.scope: An immutable release artefact reproduced under the same packaging recipe.
Layer, resolution, tile, feature and run identities.
Published source/recipe lineage after the declared transport-only projection.
Hydrology, routing, connectivity and dependency graph products.
Biome, species, resource, settlement and other categorical conclusions.
Integer, Boolean, ID and exact-boundary rasters under a canonical dtype/order header.
Continuous raster/array output in the PINNED environment.
Stage 6C terrain-refinement Float32 elevation output in an explicitly PERMITTED_PORTABLE environment.
preserves: values within the declared ceiling tolerance

artifact_families.scope: Hydrology-reduction Float64 discharge output in an explicitly PERMITTED_PORTABLE environment.
preserves: values within the declared ceiling tolerance

artifact_families.scope: Queue order, temporary task boundaries, worker assignment and temporary paths.
preserves: nothing; this state must not determine published semantics

portable_use_requires: recorded maximum observed absolute, relative and ULP errors
tolerance_policy.ceiling_rule: A producer may register a stricter versioned tolerance. A looser tolerance requires a new contract version and explicit user review.
